title: Quick Venezuelan Cheese Quesadilla
description: A pungent, cheese-pull Venezuelan dish featuring cheese and emulsified sauce, all prepared in a flash. This vegan-friendly snack is a game-changer for a quick fix.

ingredients.name: Vegan Queso Emulsifier
ingredients.notes: Such as vegan mayonnaise or store-bought emulsifier.

instructions: Heat a large skillet over medium heat.
Add 1 tsp oil and swirl to coat the pan.
Place one tortilla in the pan and sprinkle shredded queso fresco on half of it.
Fold the tortilla in half to enclose the cheese.
Cook for 2 minutes or until the tortilla is crispy and the cheese is melted.
Flip the quesadilla and cook for another 2 minutes or until the other side is crispy and the cheese is melted.
Repeat with the second tortilla and remaining cheese.
